caption: The drawing depicts a lidded vessel with two large, circular side handles. The vessel is rendered in grayscale, suggesting the use of pencil on paper. The main body of the vessel is rounded and tapers slightly at the base. On the front, there is an ornate monogram consisting of interwoven letters. The lid is domed with a knob-like finial at the top, and the overall shape of the vessel is symmetrical. The handles are attached to the vessel with horizontal, ridged mounts. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset sketch of the same vessel, showing simplified dimensions and proportions. The composition is centered on the page, and a fine-line border frames the entire drawing.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
